## FieldUpdate\<T\> Struct

Represents an unchanged field, an assigned value, or an explicit field deletion\.

```csharp
public readonly struct FieldUpdate<T>
    where T : notnull
```
#### Type parameters

<a name='Meshline.Models.FieldUpdate_T_.T'></a>

`T`

The non\-null type of the field value\.

### Remarks
The default value means no change\. [Delete](Meshline.Models.FieldUpdate_T_.md#Meshline.Models.FieldUpdate_T_.Delete 'Meshline\.Models\.FieldUpdate\<T\>\.Delete') sets [IsDeleted](Meshline.Models.FieldUpdate_T_.md#Meshline.Models.FieldUpdate_T_.IsDeleted 'Meshline\.Models\.FieldUpdate\<T\>\.IsDeleted') without setting [IsSpecified](Meshline.Models.FieldUpdate_T_.md#Meshline.Models.FieldUpdate_T_.IsSpecified 'Meshline\.Models\.FieldUpdate\<T\>\.IsSpecified')\. Protocol serialization omits unchanged fields, writes deletions as JSON null, and writes assigned values normally\. Individual operations may prohibit deleting required fields\.
